papers.title: Minimum Pseudo-Weight and Minimum Pseudo-Codewords of LDPC Codes
papers.inspected_version: arXiv:cs/0606051v2,11November2006; first submission12June2006; downloaded PDF internal title-page date6May2019 is distinguished from the arXiv version stamp, not assumed a new public version
papers.comparison: Theorem3 extends Kashyap-Vardy to AWGN pseudo-weight under minimum column weight gamma, distinct-column overlap<=lambda and integral gamma/lambda; equality iff a scaled minimum-weight codeword. At gamma4,lambda2 it yields three, not our partition four or exact six. Theorem1 needs girth>=6 and is inapplicable to our cross-block4-cycles. No theorem here proves a new fixed-matrix stopping bound4/6 for our families.

excluded_or_resolved_passages.outcome: The finite-generalized-quadrangle special case is explicitly reported known; retain only the general construction-dependent conjecture as held.

version_gap: Title-page internal date2019 differs from the arXivv2 stamp2006; both recorded without inferring a later arXiv submission.
